task: Fix premium model budget enforcement bypass for platform personal agent flows in llm_factory.py and proxy_router.py, with budgets-config.yaml prerequisite and mandatory regression tests.

key_reasoning.reason: Four components need changes across two independent execution paths: llm_factory._configure_direct_runtime_overrides() (primary bug), proxy_router._resolve_tracking_identity() (secondary bug), budgets-config.yaml (config prerequisite), and test additions. Both code paths share dependencies.py helpers (check_user_budget, get_category_budget_id, get_premium_username) whose lru_cache patterns create cross-cutting test concerns.

Budget enforcement is financial access control — it governs whether users can make premium model requests, satisfying the authorization red flag. The proxy_router.py condition relaxation must preserve EPMCDME-13157 platform-only budget as a valid state. lru_cache and TTLCache frozen at process startup require autouse cache-clearing fixtures in all regression tests. Patterns exist (proxy path is the reference implementation), but dual-path correctness and cache isolation add meaningful execution risk.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): budget enforcement controls premium model access, satisfying the authorization red flag — a budget limit is the authorization gate for premium model requests.
